meta.description: Single source of truth for OpenRouter model slugs and provider env keys. Edit aliases when OpenRouter renames models (see https://openrouter.ai/models).
meta.agent_models: Most agents use defaults.default_model (anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.6) when capabilities.json sets runtime.model to null. Override per agent only when needed; avoid :free OpenRouter models in production (upstream rate limits).
meta.byok_future: Pool `venture` is not implemented in code yet. Plan: resolve apiKey via DB/vault keyed by venture_id (ExecutionContext), then fall back to platform env keys listed under credential_pools.platform.

platform.note: Communal keys for all tenants until BYOK.

venture.note: Future: store encrypted keys per venture; runtime picks venture token for generated solutions, else platform pool.
